title: Pure Yosenju
summary: Yosenju cards only, with staples and an automatic Extra Deck. Yosenju are WIND Beasts and Beast-Warriors that hit and run: most return to the hand in the End Phase, so they come back every turn. Yosenju Kama 1 bounces a card and Normal Summons another Yosenju straight after itself. The Pendulum Scales Yosenju Shinchu L and R, or Mayosenju Hitot, stretch to Scale 11 and Pendulum Summon the big Mayosenju, which bounce cards when summoned. Yosenju Misak destroys a card when Pendulum Summoned. The 2019 cards lead. Yosenju Oroshi Channeling, on an empty field, searches a big Yosenju or places both Shinchus in the Pendulum Zones. Yosenju Sabu searches a Yosenju Pendulum, and Yosenju Izna stops responses to your summons. Mayosenju Hitot bounces a card and pumps every Yosenju each time you bounce one. Yosenju Wind Worship returns your Yosenjus and refills the hand to five.
